name: real_v1
description: Dependency graph of 18 US companies, 4 commodities (wti, henry_hub, copper, gold), and the S&P 500 market index. Structure from BEA 2023 input-output tables (threshold 2%), commodity exposure, and manual CapEx AI hardware links; weights from daily log-return OLS (2021-2023).
weak_weights_policy: Economically justified edges with |t| < 2 are retained in the graph so valuer agents hold the full structural belief set; their justification explicitly records the insignificant t-statistic. Economically spurious or intra-industry competitor edges are dropped during structure selection.
collinear_parents_note: Several children have two parents from one industry whose returns correlate at about 0.88 (COP/EOG -> VLO, MPC; VLO/MPC -> DAL, UAL, ODFL). OLS splits their common effect between the two, so a single |t| < 2 there does not mean a weak link: read the two weights together (for example COP -> VLO 0.54 + EOG -> VLO 0.18, against 0.70 in the single-parent chain).
start_price_source: stocks_close_raw (Yahoo Finance close adjusted for splits only, not dividends)
